abstract: The World Economic Forum's 2023 Future of Jobs Report identifies creative and media professions—including graphic designers, copywriters, and marketing analysts—as roles expected to experience the most rapid decline due to the advancement of generative AI technologies.
keyFindings: Graphic designers are expected to experience rapid job decline due to generative AI adoption.
Copywriters are among the roles employers anticipate will decline most rapidly from generative AI.
Marketing analysts face significant expected decline in employment due to generative AI capabilities.
methodology: Not specified. The excerpt does not detail the study design, sample size, data sources, survey methodology, or time period examined.
qualifiers: The excerpt uses employer expectations language ('expect to decline'), indicating these are projections rather than observed outcomes. The full scope, geographic coverage, and confidence levels are not specified in the provided excerpt.
